title: demo.chunk (server → platform, ephemeral, lowest priority)
description: Proposed by Ready Up (FLEET.md §12.2). Bytes [offset, offset + size) of the demo file. Sent on the link's lowest-priority lane: only when no other message is waiting, one at a time. Rules for the platform, with `stored` = the bytes it has contiguously from 0: offset > stored → do not write, answer demo.ack {offset: stored, error: {code: "gap"}}; otherwise write the bytes at offset (offset < stored overwrites: the server re-sends chunks whose bytes changed after they were sent, e.g. the demo header CS2 rewrites when the recording stops), stored = max(stored, offset + size), and answer demo.ack {offset: stored}. Several chunks may be in flight (the server keeps at most demo_window_kb, default 1 MiB, unacknowledged); the platform may answer chunks that arrive together with one demo.ack, but must answer within 5 s. An unknown demo_id → demo.ack {offset: 0, error: {code: "unknown_demo"}}. A chunk that would make the file larger than the platform's max_demo_size → error too_large. Nothing is spooled: after a reconnect the server sends demo.begin again and resumes from the platform's offset.

size.description: Bytes in data (decoded); chunk_size except for the last chunk of the file.

data.description: The bytes, standard base64 with padding (RFC 4648 §4).
